observations.title: Build a concealed passage
observations.player_action: Craft and place a Secret Door or Trapdoor matching a supported plank, log or stone material.
observations.outcome: Create an entrance whose appearance blends with surrounding building blocks.
conditions: External author documentation is not proof of effective JEM behavior; compare the installed version and configuration before implementation.
